en: "We did it! You were wonderful, Guld!"{w}
"Honey!"{w}
"Thanks, everyone!"{w}
"Thank youuu!"{w}
The happy pair vanished into the depths of the forest.{w}
A Fairy and a Werebeast hunter are talking about something.{w}

"Hey, Guld!
You're wonderful! Sooo groovy!"{w}
note: IKASU is dated slang for 'cool'; 'groovy' keeps the dated flavour. Speaker box ??? = Honey before her name is shown.

en: "Really, Honey?! That makes me so happy!!"{w}

"So save the forest for me.
Beat that menace of the forest, the Rampaging Elephant, okay?"{w}
"W-well, that's..."{w}
"Please, please, pretty pleeease~"{w}
note: kyuun is a cutesy pleading sound; folded into 'pretty pleeease'.

en: As you watched the two of them, a rumbling of the ground came echoing from far away.{w}
"H-Honey!{w}Th-those footsteps...!"{w}
"Guld, here it comes!"{w}
note: yatsu (the elephant) rendered 'it'.

en: "Ohh, Guld, show me how wonderful you are!"{w}
note: suteki ni natte = 'become wonderful (for me)'.

en:
"Y-you Rampaging Elephant, wrecking our forest!
I, Guld, will drive you back!!{w}Take this, my deadly arrow!"{w}
"Bwoooh!"{w}
note: Elephant bellow.

en: "Get poisoned~ Get poisoned~"{w}
note: Honey's poison chant (she is casting poison on the elephant).

en: "Now, Guld! Hit it with Pursuit!"{w}
note: Tsuigeki = the skill Pursuit (JOBABL 2:18); new term.

en:
"Wh-what are you saying, Honey?!
I don't have Pursuit!"{w}
"Whaaat?"{w}
"GYAHHH?!"{w}
"Nooo!"{w}
The pair was sent flying.{w}
"Idiot, idiot, idiot! Guld, you idiot!{w}Why can't you use Pursuit?!"{w}
note: baka x3 in a lovers' tiff; kept at 'idiot' strength, not softened to 'dummy'.

en:
"I'm sorry, Honey!
I'll come clean: I'm a phony hunter!"{w}
"I hate people who can't use Pursuit!"{w}
"Gaaaaah!"{w}
note: gaaan is the shock sound effect, voiced.

en: "Goodbyeee!"{w}
"Honey! HONEYYYYY!!"{w}
A dejected Werebeast was left behind.{w}As you quietly watched...{w}...your eyes met!{w}

"Hey there, you all. Do you like hunting?{w}I love hunting too!{w}But I'm in a fix because I can't use Pursuit."{w}{p}"Will you teach me Pursuit?{w}Then Honey will be head over heels for me!{w}...I mean, then the forest will be at peace!"{w}
Teach Guld Pursuit?
"How can this be?!{w}This person doesn't have Pursuit!"{w}
note: Said when the chosen party member lacks the skill.

en: "Thank you! Let's start the lesson right away!"{w}
You taught Guld Pursuit!{w}
"All right! Now I'm a Pursuit user too!"{w}

"You learned Pursuit!
You're wonderful, Guld!"{w}
"Thank you, Honey! Thank you, everyone!{w}Now I'm a real hunter too!"{w}

"You Rampaging Elephant, wrecking our forest!
Today I'll drive you back for sure!!{w}Take this, my deadly arrow!"{w}
"Watch me, Honey!{w}Hraaah!!"{w}
As you watched the happy pair, a rumbling of the ground came echoing from far away.{w}
"Huh?"{w}
"What's that?"{w}
"Eek?! Three of them?!"{w}

note: Chant lines kept on their own lines.

en: "Come on, come on, Guld!{w}Blow them all away with Strafe Pursuit!"{w}
note: Sousha Tsuigeki = skill Sweeping Pursuit (JOBABL 2:40); new term.

en:
"D-do you really think
someone like me has Strafe Pursuit?"{w}
Once again, the pair was sent flying.{w}
"Idiot, idiot, idiot! Guld, you idiot!{w}Why can't you use Strafe Pursuit?!"{w}

"I'm sorry, Honey!
Won't you forgive me for being so green?"{w}
"I hate people who can't use Strafe Pursuit!"{w}
Dryad
"Spring~ Spring~ I love spring~{w}So toasty, so warm, such lovely weather~{w}Spring is somehow just so springy~"{w}
note: Last line is deliberate nonsense (lit. 'spring is somehow spring').

en: A fairy is dancing merrily.{w}
note: yousei (generic fairy) for the Dryad, lowercase; the race name Fairy is a different word.

en:
"Oh my, everyone!{w}Won't you dance with me?
It's such fun! Oh-hohoho!!"{w}
note: Refined-lady speech (desuwa, oh-hoho).

en: Dance with the Dryad?
"Oh dear, what a pity. Good day to you!"{w}
"Well then, come over here, won't you?{w}And one-two, one-two~"{w}{p}"Spring~ Spring~ I love spring~{w}So toasty, so warm, such lovely weather~{w}Spring is somehow just so... HIP ATTAAACK!!"{w}
"Oh-hohohoho!{w}You were wide open!!"{w}{p}"That was a 'Do excuse me!', brought to you by the fairy of the forest!{w}Did you enjoy it? Tee-hee..."{w}
note: gomen asobase (posh 'pardon me') is presented as the name of her stunt, so quoted.

en: The next thing you knew, Taranti, an enchantress in the shape of a spider, was right in front of you.{w}
note: kizuku to: 'next thing you knew' keeps it open whether the party blacked out.

en: Taranti

"I caught some mo-ore!
Swishy-swish-swish...~{w}Hey, hey, you all~"{w}
note: shurushuru = sound of silk being spun/wound.

en: Chat with big Sis, okay?
note: oneesan = Taranti calling herself big sister; convention Sis.

en: "Why...{w}Whyyyyyy?!!{w}You could at least have a little chat with meee!"{w}
"Hgyah?!{w}I-it... hurts..."{w}{p}"I... get how you feel... loud and clear.{w}But just keep me company for a little bit... please."{w}
note: Refusal branch: the party hits her (her cry of pain).

en: "Really?{w}Ufufu, thanks!"{w}

"So, um, it's a little survey...
I won't get mad, so answer me honestly, okay?"{w}
What d'you think of me? Pretty?
note: 31 chars, a prompt; full form 'What do you think of me? Am I pretty?' if room allows.

en: "Why...{w}Whyyyyyy?!!{w}At least say I'm pretty, even if it's just flattery!"{w}
"Hgyah?!{w}I-it... hurts..."{w}{p}"I... get how you feel... loud and clear.{w}But there's something I want you to hear... please."{w}
"Ahh... I'm so happy...~"
note: Source has no {w}; none added.

en:
"Um... so, you see...{w}Actually, I have a favor to ask...{w}Do you know the flower called Rolfan?"{w}{p}"That flower smells so nice, doesn't it?{w}I thought I'd like to try wearing one,
so I went looking for it in the southeast of the forest."{w}{p}"And I found a spot on the little island in the middle
of the lake where it looks like it grows, but I just
couldn't get across, and I was stuck."{w}{p}"Hey, since you happened to be passing by,
couldn't you go get it for me?"{w}
Fetch me a Rolfan? Okay~?
"Why...{w}Whyyyyyy?!!{w}I asked you so cutely and everythiiing!"{w}
"Hgyah?!{w}I-it... hurts..."{w}{p}"I... get how you feel... loud and clear.{w}But there's nobody else I can ask... please."{w}

"Everyone takes one look at me
and runs away scared...{w}So, that's how it is~"{w}
note: tte koto de = 'so, that settles it'; leads into her thanks.

en: "Yaaaay~{w}Thank you!"{w}

note: Second page matches slice 036 row 3015.

en: Taranti set you free, all smiles.{w}
